steps.hardClue: Recover the vehicle keys, then move the truck.
steps.clue: Recover the truck keys in the future, then move the truck in the past.

steps.hardClue: Use the remote-controlled device to blast open the sealed garage.
steps.clue: Find the RC-XD Controller and use the RC-XD to blow open the garage.

steps.hardClue: Collect the swing seat and chalk, restoring the playground.
steps.clue: Collect the swing seat and chalk, then place them at the Twins’ swing.

steps.hardClue: Complete the three puzzles, then win the childhood games.
steps.clue: Complete the tree, piano and toy box puzzles, then beat the Twins’ three games.

steps.hardClue: Charge three musical items with zombie souls using the upgraded Wonder Weapon.
steps.clue: Charge the Music Box, Music Sheet and Cymbals with Sundergat kills.

steps.hardClue: Set the clock to midnight, then shoot one hand while switching timelines.
steps.clue: Set the Doomsday Clock to midnight, then shoot the red hand while teleporting.

steps.hardClue: Follow the figures from one object to the next, then return to the swing.
steps.clue: Follow the Twins from the piano to the toy box, fireplace and swing.

steps.hardClue: Interact at the swing set, enter the portal, then defeat the boss.
steps.clue: Speak to the Twins at the swing set, enter the portal, then defeat the Dark Heart.
